name: MyCospara

contacts.notes: Published on the brand's own affiliate program page, alongside the phone number +33 (0) 1 75 15 73 60.

evidence.summary: MyCospara's own affiliate program page (fetched) states verbatim that affiliates earn a percentage of every sale through a personalised link 'with no earning limit', calls the income 'transparent, unlimited', and says 'The system is simple, with no cap' - an explicit earnings-cap statement on the brand's own page, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped. No percentage rate is published anywhere on the page, so commission_rate is null.

The same brand page (fetched) describes the house as a committed, ethical Arab perfumery brand that rejects synthetic fragrances and celebrates plant-based, vegan ingredients, and publishes the contact email Contact@mycospara.com and a French phone number on the page. No creator count is published, so creator_saturation is unknown.

opportunity.compensation_notes: Percentage-of-sale commission at an unpublished rate; the brand's own page explicitly states there is no earning limit and no cap, so the cap is verified uncapped. Commission rate is not published, so commission_rate is null.
opportunity.description: Join MyCospara's own ambassador affiliate program, share its Arab perfumery fragrances with your audience, and earn a percentage of every sale through your personalised link with no cap on earnings - confirm your percentage inside the program, as it is not published publicly.
opportunity.title: MyCospara Affiliate Program (Own Program, Uncapped)

reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped earnings on the brand's own page, but the percentage rate itself is unpublished, which holds the score back.
reasons.contact_access: A contact email and phone number are published on the brand's own affiliate page.
reasons.credibility: A small French fragrance house with a complete, transparent program page but a limited third-party footprint.
reasons.niche_fit: Fragrance sits inside beauty UGC, though it is a narrower niche than skincare or makeup.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The program is open to creators, bloggers and enthusiasts through the brand's own page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is explicitly pitched at content creators with marketing tools, visuals and personalised strategy support, but no tracked creator campaign data was found.

name: CeraVe
description: L'Oréal Groupe's dermatologist-developed drugstore skincare brand, famous for its ceramide cleansers and moisturisers and a phenomenon on SkinTok; creators earn through its official TikTok Shop affiliate program, with terms published on CeraVe's own domain and joining inside TikTok Shop's Add Products flow.

evidence.summary: CollabFeed's route-verified breakdown (fetched) states CeraVe has no standalone influencer program on cerave.com, that CeraVe publishes official TikTok Shop affiliate terms on its own domain, and that joining happens inside TikTok Shop's 'Add Products' flow with no application and commission on sales. It also documents the LOREALISTAR creator club as the application route, with compensation starting as gifting, so the TikTok Shop affiliate is the recorded commission route.

TokConnect's TikTok Shop listing data (fetched) shows a CeraVe Sheer Tint Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30 listing carrying a 17% open affiliate commission with 937 creators selling it in the measured window. TikTok Shop rates are set per product by the seller, so no single program rate exists and commission_rate is null; 937 creators on one listing is a mid-to-large absolute count, not low, so creator_saturation is unknown. No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.

opportunity.compensation_notes: TikTok Shop commissions are set per product by the seller; one measured top listing paid a 17% open commission. No single published program rate and no cap statement, so commission_rate is null and the cap is unknown.
opportunity.description: Open CeraVe products inside TikTok Shop's Add Products flow, post derm-education skincare content, and earn the per-product commission shown on each listing - no application or approval wait.
opportunity.title: CeraVe TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

reasons.compensation: Real commissions exist and one measured listing paid 17%, but rates are per-product and unpublished at program level, so the score stays mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: There is deliberately no public partnership email; access is self-serve inside TikTok Shop.
reasons.credibility: A L'Oréal Groupe flagship with dermatologist positioning and enormous retail distribution.
reasons.niche_fit: Core SkinTok brand; ceramide routines and derm education are exactly what skincare creators post.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open affiliate route with no application - any eligible TikTok Shop creator can add the products today.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A year of tracked paid placements from nano to celebrity accounts, plus 937 creators selling one measured TikTok Shop listing.

name: Neutrogena
description: Kenvue's mass-market dermatologist brand behind Hydro Boost and the Collagen Bank pre-aging line, which Kenvue chose to debut through TikTok Shop; creators sell its products through TikTok Shop affiliate links and earn commission on purchases.

evidence.summary: A beauty-industry newsletter (fetched) reports Kenvue's announcement that Neutrogena's Collagen Bank line made its retail debut through TikTok Shop, putting the brand's products into TikTok Shop's affiliate commerce system where creators earn commission on tagged sales.

A creator post from September 2026 (fetched) announces Neutrogena's official arrival on TikTok Shop, stating the brand is offering higher commission rates and free samples to affiliate creators; a second fetched creator post discloses earning commission on Neutrogena purchases made through his TikTok Shop links. Rates are set per product and are not published at program level, so commission_rate is null; no cap statement or creator count is published, so cap and saturation are unknown. An August 2026 CollabFeed check found no public route beyond agency casting, which the later TikTok Shop launch supersedes for the affiliate layer.

opportunity.compensation_notes: TikTok Shop commissions are set per product by the seller and are not published at program level, so commission_rate is null; launch coverage reported boosted rates and free samples for affiliate creators. No cap statement is published.
opportunity.description: Find Neutrogena products in the TikTok Shop Product Marketplace, tag them in Hydro Boost and Collagen Bank content, and earn the per-product commission shown on each listing.
opportunity.title: Neutrogena TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

reasons.compensation: Commissions are real but undisclosed and set per product, with only launch-period reporting of boosted rates.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnership contact exists; the brand's own FAQ warns legitimate outreach never comes from free email accounts, and access is self-serve in TikTok Shop.
reasons.credibility: A flagship Kenvue brand and one of the most recognised skincare names in US mass retail.
reasons.niche_fit: Hydro Boost is a perennial creator favourite and the Collagen Bank launch was aimed squarely at TikTok skincare audiences.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open through TikTok Shop's product marketplace to eligible affiliate creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Regular tracked paid placements plus disclosed affiliate hauls after the TikTok Shop debut, though the paid layer remains agency-led.
